summary: State reset and conditional network init: clears byte_7CD850, refreshes the network browser UI via sub_475150(this), then conditionally starts network discovery. StartNetworkUpdate(dword_7CD25C) runs only when dword_7D0E74 is zero, byte_7D0FAC is nonzero, and the flag byte at this+0x17C is still zero; it then sets that flag to 1. Returns the value of dword_7D0E74 (or the inner flag/byte on short-circuit paths).

operations.description: Call sub_475150(this) to refresh the network game browser UI list.
Guard: proceed to LAN discovery only when dword_7D0E74 is zero; otherwise skip (result stays dword_7D0E74).
Guard: proceed only when byte_7D0FAC is nonzero (discovery enabled).
Guard: proceed only when the flag byte at this+0x17C is zero (not yet started).
Call StartNetworkUpdate(dword_7CD25C) to start LAN network discovery.
Set the flag byte at this+0x17C to 1 to mark network update as started.
Return result: dword_7D0E74 when the outer guard fails, otherwise the inner flag/byte value.
